title: Ludipe - Exploring Pacifist Roguelikes
speaker: Ludipe
description: Combat has always been the core interaction of the roguelike genre but, is there space for games that aren't focused on whacking goblins in the head? Why would we make a pacifist roguelike? And the most dreadful question of all, how do we make sure the mechanics are still engaging and interesting?
